'''2012 European Championship Ben Smyth LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ben Smyth]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step (V)}}
* '''Username:''' spambidextrous
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
